text.text_excerpt: I had an awesome meal here on Friday night! The service was friendly, and the food was delicious. My fiancé and I split the dip sampler appetizer, a small fresco salad, and a small meat pizza. The dip appetizer was delicious and was a lot of food. The salad was great- especially the house made balsamic dressing. It was so good I asked the waitress if they by chance sold it. Which sadly they don't :(. The pizza was fresh, the meats were great, and the cheese was really creamy and melty. It was a great quality pizza. Overall a wonderful meal! EXCELLENT. It's open late (1 am), the food is always CONSISTENTLY delicious, the portions are huge and cheap, AND it's healthy. So perfect for late night binges when the "best" thing you can find is greasy fast food! They do dine-in, delivery, or takeout! My favorite is the Fresco special which is grilled chicken breast, marinara sauce, mozzarella cheese, roasted red peppers, and red onions, dressed with lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise all for UNDER $9. Plus it comes with roasted potatoes, or you can splurge for $1 and make your side a salad. Their caesar salad is delicious and a huge portion for a side. That plus half of the sandwich and I'm stuffed, so it's definitely perfect for hungove...

Very good food and very good staff. As a local college student, Fresco is very conveniently located and has great business hours - making it a place that I eat at frequently. There are about 7 things that I have tried, and haven't had anything bad. The BBQ Lavash roll is the best I've had , and the turkey sandwich (though still delicious) is the most underwhelming of these. Pizza is also very good. Only two complaints really about the menu is that it's a bit overpriced, and the side options are t diverse at all. Please get fries.
